content: The 'Five Rights' of CDS (Osheroff/AHRQ, adopted by AHRQ/ONC): right information, to the right person, in the right format, through the right channel, at the right time in the workflow. Information must be derived from a reputable evidence source, targeted at someone who can act on it, actionable but not overwhelming, and delivered at the exact point of decision - too early is ignored, too late is irrelevant. GUIDES checklist is the companion implementation framework.
